name: shadowdroid
description: Run, test and debug Android apps from Claude Code: works through the ShadowDroid CLI, and opens a live, interactive emulator/device viewer in the Claude Desktop browser pane when you want to see the app, with Apply Changes builds, annotations you leave on the device, recorded steps for tests, and a status line with the device and what each build did.

viewer.title: Device viewer
viewer.description: on-request: Claude works through the shadowdroid CLI and opens the live device viewer when you ask to see the device (or run /device show). always: Claude opens the viewer whenever it runs your app. Ignored when ShadowDroid's show_device setting is window (shadowdroid config init --user --show-device window), which uses the emulator's own window instead.
